items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: This was Vic Dickenson, myself, Arvell Shaw, Kansas Fields, George Wein on the piano.

ctx.x: Yes. And Louis couldn't record. They had a record date but they wouldn't let him record. He was under contract already to another company. So they had already hired Earl Hines, Arvell Shaw and Barney Bigard. Teagarden didn't make it either. So they called me on trumpet and we made the date.
Well that was a pretty successful date apart from the recording quality wasn't very good. Things like, 'Night life in Pompei', they were very good.
